meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw a zero on his phone in class. Who decided that?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Save it. What do you have?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Take the zero off, then talk.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
We're not. Three tries and still no document.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology for how Owen found out, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing; you never put any evidence in front of her, so she had nothing to weigh.
What cost ground: You answered her question about who decided with praise and then talk of being on the same team, which she treats as a dodge and which made her sharper each turn.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your evidence never came close to that night because you showed none. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work and offer procedure 4.4 in writing.
